The mood

November check: post-monsoon is the sweet spot. Shivanasamudra still has strong flow, the ghats are green, Nandi Hills cloud-sea season is opening, and Hampi is back in its Oct–Feb window. Two cautions: the Bandipur forest stretch (Wayanad road) shuts 9 PM–6 AM, and Pondicherry sits in north-east monsoon season, so watch the rain forecast there.
